housing.summary: Numbeo reported EUR 1,532.09 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Munich city centre, last updated 1 September 2026: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Munich?displayCurrency=EUR. German Civil Code section 551 caps a residential cash deposit at three months of rent excluding operating costs: https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/bgb/__551.html. Munich's housing office names ImmobilienScout24 and ImmoWelt as popular online property portals: https://stadt.muenchen.de/service/en-GB/info/fachbereich-wohnen/10426348/.

banking.summary: N26's official Germany page says its account requires a smartphone, a valid German address and valid photo ID; its detailed process identifies a passport or national ID and video identity verification: https://n26.com/en-de/blog/how-to-open-a-bank-account-in-germany.
required_docs: valid passport or national identity card
smartphone for application and identity verification

schools.summary: Munich offers IB, British and French curricula. Bavarian International School's official page lists all four IB programmes: https://www.bis-school.com/about/bis-at-a-glance. St. George's official FAQ lists the English National Curriculum, IGCSE and IB: https://munich.stgeorgesschool.com/faq. Lycee Jean Renoir's official page states that it follows French Ministry of Education programmes: https://www.lycee-jean-renoir.de/letablissement/.

legal_admin.summary: Register the Munich residence within 14 days after moving in, online for a main residence or in person at a Munich Citizens Office; valid identification and landlord confirmation are required: https://stadt.muenchen.de/service/en-GB/info/residence-registration/10424740/n0/.
legal_admin.registration_step: Register the residence within 14 days, online for a main residence or at a Munich Buergerbuero.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer is automatically assigned a lifelong tax identification number after first registration in Germany. If no notification arrives within three months, request renewed communication from the Federal Central Tax Office: https://online.portal.bzst.de/SharedDocs/Leistungsbeschreibung/EN/erneute_mitteilung_der_ID-Nr.html.

transport.summary: MVV is the unified local transport system for Munich and the surrounding area: https://www.mvv-muenchen.de/en/mvv-at-a-glance/. MVG sells the Deutschlandticket for EUR 63 per month across the entire MVV area and German local and regional transport: https://www.mvg.de/abos-tickets/abos/deutschlandticket.html. A foreign licence is usable for six months after first registration, then must be transferred; non-EU/EEA licences generally require theory and practical tests unless an Annex 11 exception applies: https://stadt.muenchen.de/service/en-GB/info/fuhrerscheinstelle/10424591/. Health insurance is compulsory and most people use a statutory fund; eligible newcomers choose a fund, apply to it and inform their employer or contribution-paying body: https://gesund.bund.de/en/krankenversicherung and https://www.tk.de/en/become-tk-member-2038024.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A foreign licence is valid for driving for six months after first residence registration; transfer it afterward. Non-EU/EEA licences generally require theory and practical tests unless an Annex 11 exception applies; EU/EEA licences follow separate rules.
transport.healthcare_registration: If eligible for statutory insurance, choose a statutory health insurance fund, submit its membership application, and inform the employer or other contribution-paying body; health insurance is compulsory in Germany.
